title: ARKNIGHTS FAN APPRECIATION EVENT
lines: ARKNIGHTS FAN APPRECIATION EVENT PART 1
01 NEW STORYLINE RELEASE: EP08 ROARING FLARE
STARTS FROM: April 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 7-20
02 FAN APPRECIATION SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, players can sign in for 10 days to earn the following rewards.
Day 1: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Fan Appreciation Slot Machine * 1
Day 2: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Originite Prime * 1
Day 3: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Crystalline Component * 4
Day 4: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 5: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Skill Summary – 2 * 20
Day 6: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Furniture Part * 200
Day 7: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Originite Prime * 1
Day 8: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 9: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Ethan's special outfit: Infiltrator * 1
Day 10: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Chip Catalyst * 1
NOTE:
The Top Emergency Sanity Potion from this event will be expired at May 17, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Players can earn all the rewards even without signing in consecutively.
03 EXCLUSIVE HEADHUNTING – FORGET ME NOT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, the Exclusive Headhunting, "Forget Me Not", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Exclusive Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Rosmontis [Limited] / Mudrock
★★★★★: Whisperain
★★★★: Jackie
NOTE:
Limited Operator Rosmontis can ONLY be obtained from “Forget Me Not” and will NOT appear in other Standard Headhunting.
04 FAN APPRECIATION SPECIAL LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [ Memorial-Limited Headhunting Permit] * 1 as login reward.
NOTE:
[Memorial-Limited Headhunting Permit] can only be used in Exclusive Headhunting “Forget Me Not”
This login reward only can be obtained once for each account
[Memorial-Limited Headhunting Permit] will be expired at May 14, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
05 FREE EXCLUSIVE HEADHUNTING EVERYDAY
DETAILS: During the event, players can do one free roll in “Forget Me Not” everyday.
NOTE:
The free roll will be refreshed at 04:00 everyday.
The unused free roll chance will be refreshed at 04:00 each day and thus cannot be cumulated.
06 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE AT HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: The following Operators will appear at Headhunting “Forget Me Not”.
★★★★★★: Rosmontis [Limited] / Mudrock
★★★★★: Whisperain
★★★★: Jackie
NOTE:
Limited new Operator Rosmontis can ONLY be obtained from “Forget Me Not”.
New Operator Mudrock, Whisperain and Jackie will be permanently added to other Headhunting in future update.
Rosmontis, Mudrock, Whisperain, Jackie and Amiya will gain more trust during April 30, 2021, 10:00 - May 14, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
07 FAN APPRECIATION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
EPOQUE [Passe] Series Selects – Fugue for W
EPOQUE [Passe] Series Selects – Willpower for Texas
EPOQUE [Passe] Series Selects – Lieutenant for Dobermann
08 NEW FURNITURE SET GOLDEN GAME ROOM
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Golden Game Room, will be available during the event.
09 ALL STAGES SPECIAL DROP FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DETAILS: During the event, the following items will be added to all Sanity consuming stages (except Annihilation stages) as special drop for a limited time:
Emergency Sanity Sampler (Can be used to restore 10 Sanity)
Fan Appreciation Supplies (Filled with an assortment of supplies and materials)
NOTE:
The Emergency Sanity Sampler from this event will be expired at May 17, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
10 FAN APPRECIATION LIMITED-TIME SPECIAL GIFT
DETAILS: During the event, players can claim a Celebratory Box through in-game mail each day.
SENDING TIME: First day on April 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7), then at 04:00 (UTC-7) each day. (14 mails in total)
NOTE:
Players will obtain Orundum * 800 when using the Celebratory Box for the first time.
After the first-time use, players will randomly obtain following amount of Orundum:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 800.
Celebratory Box will be expired at May 21, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Each in-game mail will be valid to claim within 3 days, please do not forget to claim.
11 FAN APPRECIATION PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at Store for a limited-time.
[DUCK LORD'S SPARE CHANGE PURSE]
INCLUDES: Originite Prime * 13, LMD * 300000
[ FAN APPRECIATION SUPPLY PACK]

INCLUDES: Originite Prime * 90, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1, LMD * 200000, Strategic Battle Record * 30, Tactical Battle Record * 50, Skill Summary – 3 * 30, Skill Summary – 2 * 50, Chip Catalyst * 4, Furniture Part * 500
[ FAN APPRECIATION HEADHUNTING PACK]
INCLUDES: Fan Appreciation Operator Permit * 1, Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1
[Fan Appreciation Operator Permit]: Allows you to select an unlimited 6-star Operator from a past Headhunting Pool up to and including "Illusions of the Past".

(Ch’en, Blaze, Exusiai, Siege, Ifrit, Hoshiguma, Shining, SilverAsh, Nightingale, Eyjafjalla, Hellagur, Saria, Mostima, Bagpipe, Aak, Magallan, Phantom, Skadi, Angelina, Schwarz, Ceobe, Suzuran, Rosa)
NOTE:
All [Fan Appreciation Operator Permit] will be expired at: July 2, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
ARKNIGHTS FAN APPRECIATION EVENT PART 2
01 RECRUITMENT OPERATORS UPDATE
UPDATE TIME: April 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Following Operators will be permanently added to Recruitment:
★★★★★★: Schwarz
★★★★★★: Hellagur
★★★★★: Astesia
★★★★★: Glaucus
★★★★: Myrtle
★★★★: Sussurro
NOTE:
When Recruitment Operators update, the Recruitment tags will be forced to refresh. Please pay attention to related update notices.
02 NEW ANNIHILATION – THE GRAND KNIGHT TERRITORY OUTSKIRTS
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-8

DETAILS: After an Annihilation Mission ends, the stage will be added to the list of Hypothetical Annihilation Targets. Periodically, a stage from the Hypothetical Annihilation Targets will become a Practice stage. Completing Practice Mode can award the corresponding medals and one-time rewards, but will not award Orundums.
03 NEW LUCKY DROP THEMED FURNITURE SET – WHITE HORIZONS
UPDATE TIME: April 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DROP FURNITURE: White Horizons
HOW TO COLLECT: Lucky drop on every stage of Main Storyline (excluding Challenge Mode and tutorial stages) and every stage in Supplies.
DETAILS:
New lucky drop furniture set White Horizons will replace the current lucky drop furniture set Healthy Diner. After the replacement, Healthy Diner themed furniture set will be available at the Store.
NOTE:
Healthy Diner will be available at the Store after April 30, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7).
